You build SCENES (screens) for Lumen. Contract: SceneModule in src/core/ui.ts — each folder src/scenes/<id>/index.ts(x) default-exports a SceneModule (or array). Scenes get { services, params }. Scenes never import other scenes, systems or minigames: they discover everything through services.registries (minigames, cases, diagnoses, modes, hub entries, hud widgets), render engagement widgets via <HudSlot slot="..."/> from @ui-kit, navigate with services.router.go(id, params), and use the shared run flow helpers in src/core/flow.ts (beginRun, advanceRun, playSingleCase, abandonRun). Read src/core/session.ts (CaseSessionController/RunController), src/core/scoring.ts, src/core/tests.ts (TEST_CATALOG), and the @ui-kit and @render APIs (src/ui-kit/index.ts, src/render/**/index.ts) before you start. Use @ui-kit Screen/Backdrop/Button/GlassPanel/etc. so all screens share one visual language (GAME_DESIGN.md §3). Set `music` on the SceneModule.
Quality: this is the face of a $1M game — cinematic, layered depth, parallax, staggered entrance animations, juicy feedback (services.fx / services.audio), responsive down to 375px (phone layouts are a first-class design, not an afterthought), keyboard accessible, reducedMotion honoured. Must work even if engagement systems or some mini-games are missing (empty slots collapse gracefully). Player-facing text: never sin words.
Preview with ?sandbox=scene/<id>[&param=value] (all plugins load). Other teams may still be building systems/minigames/content in parallel; if something you need is absent, degrade gracefully and note it. For pure logic, add vitest tests.

=== YOUR SCENES ===
Scene 'title' (music 'title'): a breathtaking cinematic opening. A huge living eye centre-stage (use @render drawEye/EyeCanvas with a gorgeous iris) whose gaze follows the cursor/touch, blinks, pupil reacts to a light sweep; observatory-at-midnight backdrop with rain on glass, drifting light motes, slow parallax layers, lens flare; the LUMEN wordmark in Fraunces with a light-sweep shimmer and a subtitle ('The Eye Clinic'); 'Open the clinic' primary button (unlocks audio — services.audio.unlock() — plays 'door'/'reveal', zooms INTO the pupil as a transition before router.go('hub')); small settings/credits links. First-time players (settings.onboarded false) get a short, elegant 3-card intro (who you are, how a consult works: history → tests → diagnosis & urgency, what you can earn) then set onboarded=true. Keyboard: Enter starts.

=== YOUR SCENES ===
Scene 'hub' (music 'hub'): the Lumen lobby — the place players return to 100 times, so it must be irresistible. Top bar with <HudSlot slot='topbar-left'/> and 'topbar-right', player name, settings button. Hero: <HudSlot slot='hub-banner'/> area, then MODE CARDS from services.registries.modes (sorted by order; title, tagline, icon, accent glow, rules summary like '5 patients' / 'Endless · 3 lives' / timers; locked state with reason from mode.locked(services)); clicking starts beginRun(services, mode.id) with a door-opening transition and a 'patient:arriving' moment. Below/side: WING TILES from services.registries.hub (HubEntry: icon, title, subtitle, accent, badge(), locked()) → router.go(entry.sceneId, entry.params); <HudSlot slot='hub-sidebar'/>. Also tiles for core scenes: Arcade ('arcade'), Codex ('codex'), Profile ('profile') (only if those scenes are registered). Ambient life: a waiting-room vignette with 2-3 animated patient silhouettes/avatars (from @render) idling, rain on windows, a clock. Phone layout: stacked, thumb-reachable.

=== YOUR SCENES ===
Scene 'exam' (music 'exam'; params { caseId, modeId }): THE core gameplay screen — spec in docs/GAME_DESIGN.md §4 'Exam room'. Read the case from services.registries.cases and live state from services.session.state (start a session yourself only if none is active for this caseId — e.g. opened via sandbox). Layout (desktop 3 columns; phone = tabs Patient / Tests / Chart with a sticky Diagnose button): PATIENT column — animated <PatientAvatar> (expression reacts: pain for painful conditions, relieved after diagnosis, worried by default; external signs from findings.external), name/age/occupation/personality card, chief complaint in a typewriter SpeechBubble, triage note card; HISTORY panel — question chips grouped by category; clicking calls services.session.ask(id) and the answer appears in the patient's voice (speech bubble + chat log); KEY questions are not labelled as such. INSTRUMENT TRAY — one tool per registered mini-game (services.registries.minigames, ordered by TEST_CATALOG category), showing icon, name, minutes; done tests get a check; clicking opens a large modal stage and mounts the mini-game: mg.mount(hostEl, ctx, done) with ctx {testId, patient, findings, mode:'case', difficulty from case.difficulty, rng: services.rng.fork(caseId+testId), audio, fx, reducedMotion}; on done(result) → services.session.recordTest(result), close stage with a satisfying 'chart updated' flourish (findings fly into the chart); always call the cleanup. If the current mode's rules.autoRun !== false, offer 'Ask the technician' per tool: instant result from mg.report(findings, patient) with accuracy 0.5 & autoRun true. Tests for which no mini-game is registered are simply not shown. CHART column — RevealedFinding rows grouped by test with normal/abnormal/critical colour + icon, eye badge, newly added rows glow. TOP BAR — case progress (e.g. patient 2/5 from services.run.state), clinic minutes used, elapsed timer; <HudSlot slot='exam-overlay'/>, hint button (services.session.useHint() + bus 'hint:used'; reveals one helpful nudge e.g. an essential test not yet done or a key question category — costs efficiency). Emergency enforcement: if session.timeLimitSec is set and time runs out → services.session.fail('timeout') and go to 'results' with { caseId, modeId, timeout: true }. DIAGNOSE — opens a luxurious full-screen DIAGNOSIS BOARD: the case's diagnosis + differentials shuffled (deterministic) as elegant cards (diagnosis name from registries.diagnoses with category glyph; no summaries that give it away), an URGENCY selector (routine / soon / urgent / emergency with clear plain-language descriptions), a confirmation with a dramatic stamp; then services.session.submit(dx, urgency) → router.go('results', { caseId, modeId }). Patient enters with a door/walk-in animation on mount. Robust: mini-game throwing in mount must not crash the scene (catch, show error, allow skip).

EXTRA (from our research — learning science): (a) WORKING DIFFERENTIAL: a compact 'Suspects' board where the player can pin up to 4 suspected diagnoses at any time (searchable picker over services.registries.diagnoses) and reorder them; it persists for the case and pinned suspects that are later ruled-in/out by findings are simply the player's notes (no auto-hints). (b) On the diagnosis board, after choosing diagnosis + urgency, the player rates CONFIDENCE — 'Guessing' / 'Fairly sure' / 'Certain' — passed as services.session.submit(dx, urgency, confidence). (c) Diagnosis cards should NOT show a summary that gives the answer away; show name + category only.

=== YOUR SCENES ===
Scenes 'results' (music 'results'; params { caseId, modeId, timeout? }) and 'run-summary' (params { modeId, snapshot }). RESULTS: read services.session.state.submitted.score (ScoreBreakdown) — or the timeout case. On mount, if a run is active (services.run.state), call services.run.report(caseId, score) EXACTLY ONCE (guard against re-renders). Choreography: (1) verdict — the diagnosis card flips: correct = golden glow + hitstop + sparks + 'success'; wrong = gentle shake + reveal of the correct diagnosis with what they picked crossed out; (2) GradeStamp slams in; (3) score parts count up one by one with labels (Diagnosis, Triage urgency, Essential work-up, Efficiency, History taking, Test technique, Speed) and a total; (4) teaching: correct diagnosis summary, key findings, pearls (from registries.diagnoses), the case's teachingPoints, redFlags, management, urgency explanation; 'What you missed': essential tests skipped, key history questions unasked (list them with their answers — retrieval → elaboration), unnecessary tests; (5) rewards: every 'reward:granted' emitted while the case was active is buffered in services.session.state.rewards (they fire synchronously on submit, before this scene mounts) — cascade them in as RewardChips with sound, and also subscribe to services.bus 'reward:granted' for any that arrive later; render <HudSlot slot='results-extra'/> where engagement systems show their own panels (XP, coins, cards, rivals, streak). Timeout: services.session.state.failed === 'timeout' → a sober 'Out of time' verdict with the correct answer and teaching. (6) buttons: 'Next patient' → advanceRun(services) (if a run is active) with a big inviting style; 'Codex entry' → router.go('codex', { diagnosisId }); 'Back to clinic' → abandonRun or hub. RUN-SUMMARY: gorgeous end-of-run report: total score count-up, patients table (grade per case), best case, accuracy %, combo peak, personal-best flag, <HudSlot slot='results-extra'/>, buttons Play again (beginRun same mode) / Back to clinic.

EXTRA: show the player's CONFIDENCE (services.session.state.submitted.confidence) next to the verdict. 'Certain' + wrong = a prominent but kind 'Confidently wrong — this one will come back for review' callout (the highest-value learning moment); 'Guessing' + right = 'Lucky? Lock it in' nudge to read the key findings. End the teaching section with a one-line REFLECTION prompt card ('What clinched it?') showing the 2 most discriminating findings from the chart.

=== YOUR SCENES ===
Four supporting scenes (separate folders). ARCADE 'arcade' (music 'zen'): a beautiful grid of every registered mini-game that has practice(); pick difficulty (Easy/Clinical/Expert); mounts the mini-game in a stage with ctx.mode 'practice' and a fresh scenario from mg.practice(rng, difficulty); on done emits bus 'practice:completed' and shows accuracy, best score per game (save slot 'scene:arcade'), 'Again' button. CODEX 'codex' (params { diagnosisId? }): an illuminated-manuscript-meets-modern encyclopedia of services.registries.diagnoses grouped by category; entries are locked (elegant silhouette) until services.learning.seen(id) is true (or always open in a 'study' toggle); detail view with summary, key findings, pearls, typical urgency, reference link, mastery ring, and 'Practise a case' (playSingleCase with a case whose diagnosis matches). PROFILE 'profile': player name (editable → settings.playerName), learning stats (services.learning.stats(): diagnoses seen / mastered / due) and <HudSlot slot='profile'/> where engagement systems contribute their sections (rank, coins, streaks, emergencies). SETTINGS 'settings': master/sfx/music sliders (live), reduced motion, metric VA, high contrast, player name, export save (download JSON via services.save.exportAll()), import save (file input → importAll → reload), reset progress (confirm modal), credits & clinical disclaimer ('educational game, not medical advice'). All four: @ui-kit Screen with back button, gorgeous and consistent.
